name: Block storage decides the bill: audited public-cloud price capture and a deterministic 36-month TCO model
description: Raw price bodies captured on 2026-08-13 from the IBM Cloud Global Catalog (br-sao) and the AWS Price List (sa-east-1), the code that captured them, and a deterministic 36-month total-cost-of-ownership model for a twelve-server migration under two sizing methods. Every published number is asserted by a test, and the captured evidence recomputes to the stage hashes of the study's sealed provenance chain.

affiliation.name: Codex Hash Research Laboratory, Codex Hash Ltda., Brazil
